Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The USA players are out there in the middle and Ireland openers Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling are out in the middle too. Saurabh Netravalkar will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go..
... The Run Chase ...

After a horrific start, USA have done exceptionally well to come close to the 190-run mark. The USA top-four batters were dismissed in quick successions. Gajanand Singh and Sushant Modani steadied the ship and rebuilt the innings. They put over 100 runs together and gave the USA fans a lot to cheer about. Both the players brought up their half-centuries. Singh played an aggressive knock, while Mondani settled in and guided his innings well. The last over hustle from Marty Kain, made sure to end their innings on a high. Will USA be able to keep the Ireland batter's in check? We shall find out soon, do join us for the chase on the other side.

Andy Balbirnie and his men had a dream start with the ball, they grabbed four wickets in the Powerplay and demolished the USA top order. But since then, it's been all USA. Ireland had no answers to USA's batting in the middle and the death overs. They leaked a lot of runs and seemed to have lost their rythym. Curtis Campher did not have the best day with the ball as he went for 41 runs in his four overs. Barry McCarthy was the pick of the bowlers, he grabbed four wickets and gave Ireland the desired start. The batters now face a challenging task ahead what could have been an easy one.

An emphatic recovery for USA, after being 26 for 4 in the first six overs, USA have ended up putting a mammoth total of 188 on the board. They will be mighty pleased with their performance. The Irish men, on the other hand, will be disappointed with their show. They have an uphill task from here on.
LEG BYE! Length and on off. Kain looks to heave it away but misses. The ball brushes the pads and rolls out. They collect a leg bye. USA END THEIR INNINGS AT 188/6.
Good running! Full and on leg. Kain flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Back-to-back maximums. USA making a statement here. Full toss and outside off. Kain hangs back, swivels and smokes it over the square leg fence for a biggie.

SIX! BANG! Marty Kain is working his magic with the blade. Without any doubt he is dominating the leg side charge here. Full and on leg. Kain gets low and smokes it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Back of a length, around leg. Kain stays back and pulls it towards deep square leg and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Runs are coming in thick and fast for USA. Full and outside off. Kain shuffles across and sweeps it towards fine leg and gets a boundary. Can they cross the 180-run mark?
Mark Adair to bowl the final over.
Short ball, around off. Kain looks to pull it away. The ball goes off the outside edge to the right of the keeper. The batters take a single.
Nisarg Patel walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sushant Modani holes out now. Barry McCarthy picks up his fourth wicket of the game. A sign of relief for the Ireland camp now. Full and outside off. Modani looks to go big yet again, but does not get the desired distance on it. The ball goes towards long off, Simi Singh settles under it in the deep and pouches it comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Full, on leg. Kain clips it towards fine leg for a single.
SIX! All the way! Full and on the pads. Kain hangs back and smokes it over the square leg fence for a biggie. He gets into the act now.
50 up for Modani. His maiden fifty in T20I and what a time to get it. His team needed such an innings from him. Full and outside off. Modani slashes it through point for a single.
WIDE! Length and wide outside off, Modani leaves it alone. Wide called.
FOUR! Crunched! Low full toss and outside off. Modani leans in and swats it through point for a boundary.
Barry McCarthy (3-0-16-3) to bowl out as well.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a single. Modani moves to 45. This has been a good comeback by the home side.
FOUR! 150 is up for USA! Modani gets lucky here. Full toss and leg. Modani gets it through point off the outside edge and bags a boundary.
Full and wide outside off. Kain shuffles across and works it towards long off for a run.
Full and on off. Modani drills it towards long on for another single now.
Full and outside off. Kain punches it towards long off and gets across for a single.
Full toss, on the bodyline. Modani works it behind square for a single.

Full and outside off. Modani lofts it towards mid on. Barry McCarthy meets it on the bounce. The batters cross for a single. Modani retains the strike. Will he be able to get his side near the 170-run mark?
Curtis Campher (3-0-32-0) to bowl out.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off. Modani leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire, Adair is not at all happy with this decision.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Kain swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Top Shot! Full and on off. Kain lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary. USA are building here really well.
Full and wide outside off. Modani reaches out and swings hard at it. The ball goes towards third man and the batters take a single.
SIX! BANG! Modani puts his foot on the paddle now. Length and on off. Modani gets low and slog-sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full length and sliding down leg. Kain works it towards fine leg for a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Marty Kain hits it down the ground for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Benjamin White gets an important breakthough. He gets rid of a big fish here. Bowls it short and outside off. Gajanand Singh hangs back and looks to pull. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat to the keeper. Neil Rock behind the stump does well to collect it. An end of an excellent knock from Gajanand Singh. He has done all the damage and has laid the platform for USA to get a good score on the board.
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Benjamin White

Commentary.Commentary: Marty Kain is the new man in.
WIDE! Pushed wider, way too outside off. Left alone. Wided.
A googly, on off. Gajanand Singh looks to sweep but misses.
Short and outside off. Gajanand Singh carves it through cover-point for a brace.
SIX! There it is! Tossed up, on middle. Gajanand Singh goes down on his knee and slog-sweeps it over deep square leg for a maximum.
Clever batting! Tossed up, on middle. Sushant Modani works it to mid-wicket. He hands over the strike to Gajanand Singh.
Quicker one, outside off. Cut to point for a single. 100-run partnership comes up between Sushant Modani and Gajanand Singh.
Flatter, on off. Sushant Modani cuts it straight to point.
This is dragged down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up, on middle. Gajanand Singh dances down the track and lifts it over covers for a boundary.
On off, cut to point for a single.
FOUR! Lovely batting! Short and on middle, Sushant Modani pulls it to deep square leg to collect another boundary. USA are on a charge here.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.

FOUR! FIFTY for Gajanand Singh! What an innings this is from him. Short and leg. Gajanand Singh helps it on its way to fine leg for a boundary. He brings up his fifty and raises his bat to seal applause from the fans.
FOUR LEG BYES! Everything is going USA's way now! Loopy ball, down the leg side. Gajanand Singh looks to sweep but misses. The ball goes off the pads to fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! Gajanand Singh is playing a gem of a knock here. This was short, on middle. Gajanand Singh stands tall and sends the ball sailing over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller, on the pads. Sushant Modani works it down to long on for one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Gajanand Singh works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off. Modani pushes it to cover for a single. The pair is making sure to keep the runs ticking.
Length ball, on off. Sushant Modani guides it to third man for three runs. Most expensive over of the innings so far. A good one for USA. 20 runs off it.
This is pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! MORE! Length ball, outside off. Gajanand Singh hangs back on and tonks it over long off for a maximum. The fans are loving it!
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Gajanand Singh leaves it alone. Wided.
SIX! Brilliant shot! Short of a length, on middle. Gajanand Singh picks it up beautifully and hammers it over fine leg for a biggie.
Length ball, on off. Sushant Modani slices it over point for a single.
Fuller in length, on off. Sushant Modani lifts it over mid off for a couple of runs.
Fuller length, around the off pole. Sushant Modani drags it down the ground and scampers through to the other end.
On off, full in length. Gajanand Singh works it to long off for a single.

SIX! Bang! There comes the first maximum of the innings! Something to smile about for the USA fans out there! A loopy delivery, outside off. Gajanand Singh gets down on knee and sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Full, on middle. Sushant Modani gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. A single taken.
Tad shorter, around middle. Gajanand Singh works it away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy delivery, around leg. Sushant Modani advances down the pitch and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Simi Singh (2-0-4-1) comes back on.
Beaten! Short in length, around middle. Gajanand Singh goes for the pull but fails to get any bat on it. Dot to end the over.
Outside off, on a full length. Sushant Modani opens his face of the bat and guides it to third man for another single.
Changes his length on this occasion, goes shorter this time. Gajanand Singh pulls it towards fine leg. A single taken.
Full in length, outside off. Sushant Modani waits back and guides it to third man for a run.
LEG BYE! Serves a full-length delivery again, on the pads this time. Gajanand Singh misses his flick and the ball hits the pads and rolls towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye.
Overpitching it, outside the off pole. Sushant Modani pushes it to long off and grabs a single.
Mark Adair comes back into the attack.
Floated, full and on off. Singh defends it to the right of the bowler. White moves to that side and stops the ball.
Short, around middle and leg. Modani stays back and pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full-length, tosses it up outside off. Sushant Modani leans forward and goes for the drive but gets beaten as the ball turns away a tad bit.
Fuller, around off. Driven to long off for a run. 50 up for USA. Still a long way to go.
FIVE WIDES! Much-needed this for USA! Shorter, down the leg. Gajanand Singh looks for the sweep shot but misses. The keeper too can't get hold of that and the ball races away for a boundary.
Loopy delivery, very full, around leg. Sushant Modani pushes it towards long on for a single.
Tad fuller, around middle and leg. Gajanand Singh tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Serves a shorter one this time, on the body. Gajanand Singh pulls it away towards fine leg. Couldn't get hold of that one and he will grab a single.
NO BALL! Fuller in length, around middle Gajanand Singh punches it towards long on for a couple of runs. Curtis Campher has overstepped here and a no-ball is called. Free hit coming up.
Taking the pace off, full-length delivery, outside off. Sushant Modani hangs back and guides it towards third man and rotates the strike.
Fuller this time, outside off. Sushant Modani drives it through the covers for a brace.
Maintains the same length, on off, shaping it into the right-hander. Sushant Modani cuts it to point. He wanted a single there, but was sent back by his partner.
On a length, outside of. Gajanand Singh pushes it towards deep point for a run.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Sushant Modani pushes it to long on. A single taken.
Floated, full and on off. Singh pushes it to cover.
Tossed up, wide of off. Singh stays back and looks to cut it away but misses.
Around off, Singh looks to chase it but misses.

Good fielding in the deep by Barry McCarthy. Short and outside off. Singh cuts it through point. Barry McCarthy covers a lot of ground to his right and puts in a dive to keep the ball in play. The batters take a couple.
Full and on off. Modani pushes it towards mid off and gets a single.
LEG BYE! Looped up, around leg. Singh looks to sweep it away but misses. It brushes the pads and goes towards square leg. The batters collect a leg bye.
Benjamin White will roll his arm over now.
On a length, around middle and leg. Singh whips it across the line towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Modani leans back and steers it towards third man. They get a single.
A single now! Length and outside off. Singh punches it to the left of deep point. The batters cross for a single.
Full and on off. Singh drives it to cover. Not in the gap though.
Length, around middle and leg. Singh defends it back to the bowler.

A mix-up but safe! Full and on leg. Singh clips it to mid-wicket. He ventures out of the crease looking for a single, but was sent back. There was a misfield which allowed Singh to get back into the crease.
Curtis Campher comes to the attack now.
Floated, full and on off. Modani defends it out watchfully. A good over by Simi Singh, 3 runs off it.
Flatter and outside off. Modani defends it to the off side.
Darted, on the pads. Gajanand Singh clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Gajanand Singh defends it back to the bowler.
Floated, around off. Modani works it to cover for another single.
Full, on leg. Gajanand Singh clips it to mid-wicket for a single.

Fuller and on off. Singh drives it towards cover. The batters take a single. Singh retains the strike here. A good over for USA, from the runs perspective but they have dug a huge hole in terms of the wickets.
A couple now! Fuller, on the pads, Singh clips it to fine leg. The wicket-keeper chases it and keeps it down to two.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Gajanand Singh gets off the mark in some fine fashion. Full length and outside off. Singh hangs back and punches it through backward point for a boundary.
Length and on off. Singh works it to cover off the outer half.
Gajanand Singh comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ryan Scott tries to be adventerous and pays the price. Barry McCarthy picks up his third wicket of the game inside the Powerplay. Fuller, on the pads. Scott flicks it aerially towards deep square leg and picks up the only man stationed there. Lorcan Tucker takes a good catch above his head and USA is in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Smacked! Scott gets the first boundary of the game and for the USA at a big stage. Full-length, around middle and leg. Scott goes back and drills it through long on for a boundary. Something to cheer about to the USA fans.
On off, Sushant Modani covers the line and defends it out.
Sushant Modani is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust for USA! Tossed up, on middle and leg. Ritwik Behera gets down on one knee and looks to sweep. He misses and gets hit on the pads. Simi Singh pleads the umpire for an lbw and he raises his dreaded finger. It looked like it might be going down leg but the umpire thinks otherwise and USA have lost their third wicket inside the Powerplay now.
Tossed up, on middle. Nudged to mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, Ryan Scott pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Ryan Scott pushes it towards covers.
Floated it up, on middle and leg. Ryan Scott looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Simi Singh appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no.
Simi Singh comes into the attack now. He replaces Mark Adair.
Good-length ball, on off. Ritwik Behera defends it past the bowler towards mid on. Another good over from Barry McCarthy. A wicket and one run from it.
On a good length, on middle. Ritwik Behera pushes it to mid on.
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Ritwik Behera leaves it untouched. Wided.
Ritwik Behera comes out to bat at number 4.

OUT! TIMBER! Barry McCarthy gets another one! Bowls it on a good length, on middle and leg. Xavier Marshall advances down the track and tries to play a release shot but doesn't get to the pitch of the ball. He misses it completely and the ball sneaks past his blade and knocks the bails off. USA lose their second wicket.
Good-length ball, on middle and leg. Xavier Marshall looks to work it on the leg side but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Barry McCarthy appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no.
Fuller this time, on middle. Pushed to mid on.
Length ball, down leg. Xavier Marshall looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes off his pads and carries through to the keeper.
On middle, Xavier Marshall flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Ryan Scott tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on middle. Xavier Marshall works it to wide of mid on for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Ryan Scott pushes it towards point for a run.
Length ball, on middle. Xavier Marshall works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Xavier Marshall punches it towards covers.
Mark Adair to bowl from the other end.

Length ball, on leg. Xavier Marshall looks to work it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes off the pads to square leg and the batters take a leg bye. A good start from Barry McCarthy. A wicket and just 5 runs from it.
On a good length, outside off. Xavier Marshall blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Ryan Scott cuts it to third man for a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Xavier Marshall tucks it on the leg side and gets off the mark with a single.
Who will walk out now? It will be Xavier Marshall.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Barry McCarthy strike off the second ball of the over. Ireland are up and running! Back of a length, around off. Monank Patel stays back and looks to punch on the back foot. The ball gets too big on him and finds the outside edge. Neil Rock behind the stumps makes no mistake and Monank Patel has to walk back to the pavilion for a timid score. Not the start USA were looking for!
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Barry McCarthy

Commentary.Commentary: Runs straightaway! Barry McCarthy bowls it fuller, on the pads. Monank Patel flicks it behind square on the leg side. The fielder there half-stops it and the batters take a couple of runs.

Both the teams walk out to the field and line up for the National Anthem. It will be Ireland's first followed by the USA's. We are inching closer to the start. Ireland players take the field. Followed by Ryan Scott and Monank Patel who walk out to bat for USA. Barry McCarthy to start with the ball. Here we go...
Ireland (Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Lorcan Tucker, Curtis Campher, Shane Getkate, William McClintock, Neil Rock (WK), Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Benjamin White.
USA (Playing XI) - Monank Patel (C/ WK), Gajanand Singh, Nisarg Patel, Ritwik Behera, Ryan Scott, Sushant Modani, Xavier Marshall, Yasir Mohammad, Saurabh Netravalkar, Ali Khan, Marty Kain.
TOSS - USA have won the toss and have opted to BAT first.

The USA too have a good set of players in their squad. They will miss the services of Jaskaran Malhotra who smashed 6 sixes in an ODI against Papa New Guinea earlier this year but the side have talented players and will be very keen to start with a win and make a mark in this series. Stay tuned for further updates.

This is the first time that any member of the ICC will be touring the USA for a series. This will be the first assignment for the Andy Balbirnie-led side after the T20 World Cup 2021. They had a forgettable campaign as they failed to qualify for the Super 12 stages and now will be eager to bounce back here. They have plenty of experienced players in their unit and on paper are favourites to win this game.

Hello everyone! Welcome to the first T20I of the 2-match T20I series between Ireland and USA. All eyes will be on USA as they are hosting this series and could be a turning point with respect to the development of cricket in USA. Ireland have played more T20Is but they would be aware of their opponents capabilities and won't be taking them lightly. Will the Monank Patel-led side turn up big against the strong Irish side? We shall find out.
... MATCH DAY ...
